shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g '*config*' -g 'index.html' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'chartkit|yagr|charts|monitor' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && ls -la'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit @gravity-ui/charts @gravity-ui/yagr @gravity-ui/icons'
/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Select SegmentedRadioGroup Checkbox Switch Modal Tooltip && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Select SegmentedRadioGroup Checkbox Switch Modal Tooltip && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for (const p of ['chartkit','charts','yagr','icons']) {const m=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json'); console.log(p,m.version, m.peerDependencies)}\" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md | head -100 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/package.json | head -90 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -140'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build | rg 'docs/|gravity-charts.*(d.ts|js)"'$|yagr.*(d.ts|js)$'"' | head -75 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md | head -65 && rg -n 'ChartLine|ArrowDownToLine|ArrowUpRight|ChevronDown|CircleQuestion|ArrowRotateRight|Ellipsis|Calendar|Gear|ArrowRight|Moon|Sun|Xmark|ChartArea' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -40 && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/widget.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/useWidgetData.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/index.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/index.js'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts | rg '(line|axis|chart|legend).*d.ts"'$'"' | head -45 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr | rg 'd.ts"'$'"' | head -35 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -130 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -150 && rg -n 'Gear|Moon|Sun|Pulse|HeartPulse|Database|CircleCheck|Check|Clock|Sliders|Xmark|ArrowsExpand' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/index.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/plugin.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/utils.js | head -190 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types/chart-data.d.ts 2>/dev/null && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types | head -55'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'export (type|interface) (ChartData|LineSeries|XAxis|YAxis)|dashStyle|lineWidth|tickInterval|grid|tickPixelInterval|tickFormat' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types -g '*.d.ts' | head -75 && rg -n 'export (interface|type) (YagrConfig|RawSerieData|Axis)|timeMultiplier|legend|grid|axes|width|color|show' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -80 && rg -n -C 3 'text-positive|text-info|text-utility|base-float|line-generic' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types/index.d.ts | head -120 && rg -n 'ChartData|lineWidth|dashStyle|tickInterval|tickPixelInterval|grid' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -80 && sed -n '43,85p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts && sed -n '170,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts && sed -n '250,318p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts && head -65 node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/plugins/legend/legend.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts && sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts && sed -n '180,275p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts && sed -n '230,310p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/series.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && rg -n 'ControlGroupProps|onUpdate' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -20 && rg -o -- '--g-color-(text-positive|base-positive["'^:, ]*|text-utility|infographics-[a-z-]+|base-background|base-float|text-complementary)'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/chart.d.ts | head -90 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/marker.d.ts | head -60 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/components/ChartKit/ChartKit.js | head -120 && rg -n 'text-info|text-secondary|text-positive|base-neutral' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_light.scss | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -- '--g-button-border-radius|--g-button-text-color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -12 && rg -n -- '--g-segmented|border-radius' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.css | head -25 && cat vite.config.ts"
